chapter_seo_title: Seven Mysteries Sect: Li Feiyu's First Kill & Han Li's Ghost-Blade Massacre
chapter_meta_description: Trapped by a coward's token and surrounded by Duan Shui Sect assassins, Li Feiyu unleashes his rage—and Han Li shows his true shadow-blade lethality. No one escapes.
og_title: Ghost in the Dark: Han Li's Invisible Blade
og_description: Li Feiyu gets his first real fight while Han Li turns into a flickering ghost—chapter 80 of A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality delivers a short, savage massacre.
twitter_description: The Duan Shui Sect runs. They don't make it. Li Feiyu's blade and Han Li's shadow end the chase before it begins.
